restore.title: Restore a backup
restore.description: Select a JSON backup created by Planora to replace your current workspace.
restore.fileType: JSON file · Backup formats v1 and v2
restore.valid: Compatible backup. Review its contents before restoring.
restore.invalid: This backup is invalid, too large, incomplete or incompatible with this version of Planora.
restore.behaviour: Restore replaces your current account data with the contents of the backup. You can review a summary before continuing.
restore.success: Restore complete: {count} records restored. Your previous data was replaced and imported reminders are disabled.
restore.error: Restore failed. The database rolled back the transaction and your previous data remains unchanged.
restore.confirmDescription: Your current data will be replaced by this backup. Planora validates the file before making any change and downloads a safety copy first.
restore.replaceWarning: Schedules, categories, tasks, events, history, templates and reminders not present in this backup will be removed.

privacy.title: Privacy and control
privacy.description: Your exports are prepared on this device for you to download. Keep backups in a safe place: they may contain personal information.
